name: student-platform
description: Student ecosystem platform (working brand: LINK). Monorepo: NestJS API + Next.js web + shared packages.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @platform/contracts && npm run build -w @platform/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @platform/api && npm run build -w @platform/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n pkgs,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -k -n contracts,client "npm run dev -w @platform/contracts" "npm run dev -w @platform/api-client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run test:e2e -w @platform/api
